delivery_rule: Qualified native and repaired entities may be delivered with image-local, evidence-bound limitations. A limitation blocks its affected uses and scope, never counts as repaired data, and does not by itself block unrelated qualified entities. Structural integrity remains mandatory.

readiness.MATERIALIZED: All selected physical entities exist; not yet independently accepted.
readiness.READY: Structural build checks passed; candidate only.
readiness.ACCEPTANCE: Separate complete cold receipts; Owner final acceptance and production switch remain separate.

transition_rule: Reuse exact independently verified Base 2.2 files; close only registered open knowledge intervals for qualified new observations. Preserve original atoms and closed intervals. Retain scope-specific unavailable source observations and all frozen consumer gates; no completeness is inferred from physical table count.
